destination.name: De Nederlandsche Bank
destination.note: No installed model, native-kit POI or poi-work-queue task covers it (checked by name and pand id); no OSM POI exists, so a model-local landmarkId is used. The brief attributed the 1991 rotunda to Jo Coenen; every source names J. Abma (1990). The rotunda (BAG pand 0363100012178159) is demolished, so it is not modelled.

sources.use: Mecanoo renovation, brick-and-brown-tile facade, round tower demolished
tower ~70 m tapering window strips, exposed-aggregate red-brown tiles, satellite tower by J. Abma 1990
110x120 m podium, 73 m tower; aerial, site plan, ground plan, elevations (ref-ad-*.jpg)

photos.note: Amsterdam panorama perspective thumbnail (distorted), shows rotunda still standing
third-party drawings and aerials, reference only, medium-resolution as published

decisions: 3DBAG shell (older than the demolition) includes the cylindrical satellite; its surfaces (centroid within 16.5 m of 0.5,20.7 east/south, higher than 20 m) are skipped and the open edges are closed with fans (tile colour).
UNRESOLVED: the 3DBAG link core / annex (x 14-26, z -8..22, up to 51-64 m) west of the tower probably belonged to the satellite too and is kept; 2025 photographs show a clean west face.

Podium storey levels (ground 5.9, eave 13.1) from 3DBAG; tile fascia, ribbon windows (2.2 m pitch), white spandrel inferred from the 2025 photos and panoramas. Facade materials differ per side in panoramas (pre-renovation); the model uses the renovated tile fascia on all sides.
Tower: 12 window strips at 3.6 m pitch above the podium plus two technical strips, from the Mecanoo east elevation; window pitch 1.3 m by eye.
